text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is approaching. King Halo asks Seiun Sky why she continues to perform well if she doesn't care about the attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky explains she just wants to win. She goes on to say, "at your final wrong turn, you'll have found the right path," lighting a fire in King Halo's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The same day, we run into another racer from the same year, Grass Wonder. She's recovered from an injury and is back in tip-top shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky tries to get her to lower her guard, but it doesn't work. It seems the Arima Kinen won't be won easily.
